name: Blue Finest (NYPD)
description: Fuselage: Deep royal blue (NYPD blue) from the nose to the aft door, belly included; behind the aft door the fuselage is white with a broad green band across the window line and a second green band low down, after the NYPD flag. Tail: Blue fin with about twenty white stars in a rounded cluster across its middle. Engines: Blue with white 'jetblue.com', polished lips. Winglets: Green wingtip fences. Titles: White 'jetBlue' forward; 'HONORED TO SUPPORT NEW YORK'S FINEST' in small white italic capitals above the aft windows; 'Blue Finest' small under the cockpit. Artwork: the NYPD flag's colors and stars.

notes: Registration settled: the 2024-07-26 photo shows N531JL with 'Blue Finest' under the cockpit (the N569JB pairing in a hobbyist list is wrong). Drawn from one right-side photo; the left side wasn't seen clearly, and the lower green band is only seen from below (low). Re-checked 2026-11-15: 'jetBlue' placed as on the standard (measured in metres on the A321neo N2017J and checked on A320s: x 0.174-0.356 of an A320, cap 1.57 m, lowercase 0.76 of the capitals); 'jetblue.com' on the A320's nacelle x 0.43-0.79 (read off N615JB and N627JB); the name under the cockpit given its length.
